```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create example DataFrame
df_pd = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana", "Eve"],
    "spend": [500, 1500, 1000, 750, 2000]
})

# Convert to narwhals and add tier column
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)
df_with_tier = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then("gold").otherwise("standard")
)

# Display result
print(df_with_tier.to_native())
```
